name: Demos
description: Lists and downloads the server-side demo files an instance recorded, newest first, with every file of one match collapsed into a single row. Recognises raw .dm_91 by default; other addons extend the recognised formats and add per-match actions through the two extension points this addon declares (file_kinds, match_groups). Needs QLSM with ui_api 3 or newer - the screen is the addon's own component and renders its whole dialog.

file_kinds.description: Filename extensions to list and allow downloading alongside the raw .dm_91 files this addon recognises on its own. Contributors return a flat list of extensions without the leading dot, e.g. ["qlmatch"].

match_groups.description: Groups of files that belong to one match, so a pack and its sidecars read as a single row. Dispatched with (instance_id, demos) -- the flat file list already built -- and a contributor returns fully-resolved groups: [{group_id, label, member_names, addon_id, actions: [{id, label, icon, danger, action: {route, method, confirm}}]}]. Routes are relative to the CONTRIBUTING addon prefix; addon_id says which.
